what: How a GPS fix becomes a point in the hall frame. Read by photo_meta.py.
origin_what: roof centre measured on Esri Wayback 37890 (Maxar WV-3, 2020-10-30); building frame u (bearing 54, NE) / v (bearing 144, SE)

hall_from_building.z: z = -(v - joint_v_m) (hall +z = NW, the entry end)
hall_from_building.why: the nave (span 3) is centred at u = 10 on the satellite; the expansion joint (hall z = 0) at v = -2 (roof seam and the lantern gap). The roof edge and the 108 m grid disagree by 1.5 m.

utc_offset_note: Armenia, AMT, UTC+4, no daylight saving; the photos' OffsetTimeOriginal says +04:00 too

satellite.image: hall-arch/sat_wb37890_z18_stitch.png (session scratchpad, not in the repo: Esri imagery is not ours to redistribute)
satellite.note: z18 web-mercator stitch, north up; origin_px is the roof centre
